import statistics
import time

QUERIES = 1000  # the declared sample size


def p95_ms(search, corpus, queries):
    samples = []
    for q in queries[:QUERIES]:
        start = time.perf_counter()
        search(corpus, q)
        samples.append((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
    return statistics.quantiles(samples, n=100)[94]

def search(corpus, term):
    return [doc for doc in corpus if term in doc["body"]]
